from collections import Counter

def find_furthest_range(nums, window_size):
    # Count occurrences of each number in the window
    window_counter = Counter()
    for num in nums[:window_size]:
        window_counter[num] += 1
    
    max_range = window_size
    current_max = window_counter.most_common(1)[0][1]
    
    for start, end in enumerate(nums[window_size:], window_size):
        window_counter[nums[start]] -= 1
        if window_counter[nums[start]] == 0:
            del window_counter[nums[start]]
        window_counter[nums[end]] += 1
        
        current_max = min(current_max, window_counter.most_common(1)[0][1])
        max_range = min(max_range, end - start + 1 - current_max)
    
    return max(nums), max_range
